input:
Earlier scenes:
这个男孩子叫孟子，孟子是古代的人。孟子的妈妈觉得住在哪儿对童年很重要，所以他们常常搬了家。她望子成龙，所以孟子的妈妈安排他的生活。因为他们常常搬了家，中国人说，孟母三迁。孟子没有爸爸，所以，他的妈妈更重要。从这儿到那儿，妈妈教孟子很多技能。先她让孟子跟朋友玩儿，然后教他怎么买又便宜又好质量的东西。

This scene:
最后，她让孟子学写作。他不是写作就是看书，难怪他很聪明。现在在中国，孟子很有名。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
(none on this scene)

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “他不是写作就是看书” / Formula: 不是 + A + 就是 + B means “either A or B”; use it only when presenting two alternatives. For habitual actions, use 一边……一边……, or simply list the actions. / Correct: “他不是写作，就是看书。” This sentence is grammatically correct, but it means he was always doing one of these two things. A more natural version is: “他常常写作、看书。”
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] Incorrect phrase: “现在在中国，孟子很有名” / Formula: Time expression + Subject + Predicate; avoid placing both 现在 and 在中国 before the subject when the location is not essential. / Correct: “现在，孟子在中国很有名。” More naturally: “如今，孟子在中国非常有名。”

items.reason: “不是写作就是看书” is a grammatical and natural way to say that he was always either writing or reading.
“现在在中国，孟子很有名” has acceptable time-and-place word order and is fully grammatical.
